curated.instructions: omr/instructions/8828-1/ (scans; the loader is pages 001-005, steps 1-18, the grader after, and page 011 adds the 8720 motor)

functions.does: The crank on the right side raises and lowers the loader arms with the bucket: it turns a worm, which turns a 24-tooth gear and, through a pair of bevel gears, a cross axle under the front of the chassis; two arms on that axle push the black arms up through a pair of black links.
functions.source: book: steps 7-8 (insets), 10, 11, 13 and 14; the back cover draws the arms raised

functions.does: The crank on the left side tips the bucket: a crank arm on its axle pushes and pulls a pair of flex cables running forward along the arms to a lever between the arms' tips, which tips the bucket on its pivot through two black links.
functions.source: book: steps 11 (the pink inset builds the cables), 13, 16-18; the back cover draws the bucket tipping (red arrow); which crank is which is read from the model, the book doesn't say

functions.does: The round knob on the cab roof steers the rear wheels: its long vertical axle turns a pair of bevel gears and an 8-tooth pinion on a shaft running back to a rack, which swings both rear steering arms.
The four wheels roll freely; nothing drives them. The front wheels are on fixed pins, the rear wheels on the steering arms.

questions.question: Right crank lift, left crank bucket? Does the 8720 motor drive the lift?
